privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body: When you request a consultation we collect only what we need to respond: your name, how to reach you and your project details. We use it to contact you about your project and nothing else. The data is processed under the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law. You can ask us to see, correct or delete it at any time by writing to info@ashmont.com.sa. This app keeps no copy of your request on your device after it is sent, and contains no analytics or trackers.

learn.title: Terms used here
items: Yield on cost is stabilised net income divided by total cost. Build when it clearly beats the exit cap rate; the gap is your reward for development risk.
Exit value is stabilised net income divided by the cap rate. At a 7% cap, SAR 1M of net income is worth about SAR 14.3M.
Residual land value is the end value, less every other cost and the profit you need. It is the most the land is worth to this scheme.
Equity IRR is the annual return on the money you put in, after the bank is paid. Leverage raises it when the project earns more than the interest rate, and lowers it when it does not.
P10 and P90: one scenario in ten does worse than P10, one in ten does better than P90.
Permits are often the longest step you do not control. Early engagement with the municipality and Civil Defense shortens it.
